expected.fmt:
import expect_equal from "@std/test/test.ms"

export fn main() Int:
	var number = 1
	total := (
		number
		+ (
			match present(1):
				value:
					number += 1
					value
				none: 0
		)
	)
	if total != 2: return 1

	return 0

test "operands retain evaluation order":
	main() | try expect_equal(0)

fn present[T](value: T) T?:
	return value
